decisions.reason: The low-pile carpet sits close to the core offer, kept its own page in 2024 and costs little to carry in the collection, so the firm has every reason to keep showing its commitment to it.

This premium hand-knotted wool silk carpet reflects the firm's craftsmanship and fine-materials positioning, and it remained prominently presented, so dropping it would contradict the announced direction.

The corner bench went from its own page to a mere mention in 2024, which signals weaker emphasis, but the firm still publicly promotes it as a new interpretation of a classic and has invested in its design, so it stays for now.
The low-pile carpet keeps its own page and fits the established rug range, and the drop of sibling product C suggests the firm already pruned its weaker carpet variants.
The swivel shell chair is a seating product close to the core, likely tied to a designer collaboration and tooling investment, and it remains visibly presented, so the firm will persist with it.
